name: com.sharq-it.sus.core
description: Vue-inspired reactive UI framework for Unity UI Toolkit. Write a component as a single .sharq file (template + script + style) and the Editor-time compiler generates a plain C# UxmlElement class plus scoped USS. Includes reactivity (Prop<T>, Computed<T>, Watch, WatchEffect, EffectScope), template directives (v-if / v-else / v-show / v-for / slot / @event), component composition with provide/inject, design tokens with Dark/Light themes, responsive breakpoints, an overlay/portal host, world-space UI, a runtime console and devtools overlay, plus Editor tooling: Setup wizard, runtime tree inspector and theme editor under Window/SUS. Requires Unity 6.3 (6000.3) or newer for native SVG icon import.

samples.description: Component composition: SetChildProp and BindChildProp - literal and reactive props between components, mutating .Value without replacing Prop<T>.

Showcase of the full design-token system: themes (Dark/Light via T key), colors, fonts, sizes, reactive breakpoints, and SusIconElement icons - all via var(--sus-*). Includes a ready ThemeShowcase.unity scene.
SusKeepAlive example: element wrapper with hide/show toggle via display:none (DOM is preserved).

Optional full Phosphor icon set: 1,512 icons x 6 weights (MIT). The package itself ships a 127-icon subset that covers everything the components use by default; import this sample only if you need the long tail. It adds ~19 MB of SVG assets under a Resources folder, so they are included in every player build.
